changelog: CRITICAL FIX: Barcode generation was using prefix '20' (2 digits) + 9 random = 11 digits, but EAN-13 needs 12 digits before checksum. This caused parseInt(undefined) = NaN, making the barcode '20XXXXXXXXXNaN' which BarcodeDisplay rejected and fell back to CODE128. Fixed: prefix changed to '200' (3 digits) + 9 random = 12 digits + 1 checksum = 13 pure digits. EAN-13 now works correctly.
